messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed to manage polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
It is prescribed because it improves how the body responds to insulin.
PCOS affects about 1 in 10 women of reproductive age.
PCOS is often marked by insulin resistance.
Insulin resistance is a condition in which the body doesn't respond well to insulin.
Poor response to insulin prompts the pancreas to produce more.
This excess insulin drives up androgen production.
Androgen is a male hormone.
This process worsens symptoms like irregular periods, infertility, acne, and excess hair growth.
Metformin helps by lowering insulin levels.
Metformin helps by decreasing the liver's glucose production.
Metformin helps by improving glucose uptake by muscles.
Metformin helps by reducing circulating androgen levels.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular ovulation.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular menstrual cycles.
Metformin is not FDA-approved to treat PCOS.
Metformin is widely prescribed as an off-label treatment.

The relation 'used as' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug or treatment is utilized for the purpose or indication specified in the object.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are to be managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
